name: Mismatching selector
description: A workload selector that does not match its pod template labels can prevent the controller from managing the intended pods. This usually results from label drift or copy-paste mistakes.
long_description: Workload controllers (such as Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, and Jobs) rely on label selectors to identify the Pods they own. If the selector defined in `spec.selector` does not match the labels in `spec.template.metadata.labels`, the controller cannot select the Pods created from its own template. For apps/v1 workloads the API server rejects such a spec, so the mismatch shows up as a manifest that fails to apply, for example in a CI pipeline or a GitOps sync. Checking selector and label alignment catches these manifests before they are applied.
remediation: Update spec.selector, spec.jobTemplate.spec.selector, or the pod template labels so the selector matches the pod template labels.
test: Check that every Deployment, ReplicaSet, DaemonSet, StatefulSet, ReplicationController, Job, and CronJob selector matches the workload pod template labels.
